source: Health Canada EER + evidence-based food system + evidence-based heating/woody model

food_adult_equivalent_definition.definition: mean of the two representative low-active adults

adult_equivalent_scope: food-energy normalization only; not a total-land multiplier
arc_policy_definition: 1 ha per adult is evaluated by number of adults in the household allocation, while children increase food demand and shared-household land pressure

wetter_productive.label: Favourable / deep / well-drained productive soil
wetter_productive.wetness_constraint: low when managed; saturated pockets remain unsuitable
wetter_productive.notes: Favourable / deep / well-drained productive soil. This is a scenario capability band, not a parcel-level soil classification.

ordinary_mesic.label: Ordinary / mesic Grey County soil
ordinary_mesic.wetness_constraint: moderate; wet areas require separate drainage and crop placement
ordinary_mesic.notes: Ordinary / mesic Grey County soil. This is a scenario capability band, not a parcel-level soil classification.

dry.label: Dry / moisture-limited soil
dry.wetness_constraint: low wetness but high drought exposure
dry.notes: Dry / moisture-limited soil. This is a scenario capability band, not a parcel-level soil classification.

shallow_rocky_marginal.label: Marginal / shallow / rocky soil
shallow_rocky_marginal.drainage: variable; bedrock and slope dominate local conditions
shallow_rocky_marginal.notes: Marginal / shallow / rocky soil. This is a scenario capability band, not a parcel-level soil classification.
